scope: read-only production advisory and function catalog observation

advisories.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
advisories.interpretation: Includes private tables; absence of a policy can intentionally deny direct client access. Not an authorization test.

advisories.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
advisories.interpretation: Callable definer functions require individual authorization review; count alone does not prove an exploit.

limits: Point-in-time catalog metadata, not a backup or authorization proof.
Observed hashes must not replace independently reviewed installation guard expectations.
No passwords, tokens, user rows, or signing keys read.
No production SQL, policy, key, or Auth setting changed.

additional_readonly_catalog_checks.limits: Catalog-only checks do not prove authenticated company/owner isolation or RPC authorization. No user records queried and no production changes.

personnel_policy_observation.select_rule: account_access_allowed AND matching worker/company AND (self user OR company personnel view permission with worker status/admin conditions)
personnel_policy_observation.hook_observation: Read-committed account deletion advisory barrier and restriction recheck are present.
limits: Catalog review only; no actual authenticated owner/company test executed against production.
Observed helper/hook does not itself establish general live-auth-session revocation; do not infer it from the deletion barrier.
Do not automatically rewrite existing roles, RLS, helpers or hooks based on this observation.

document_exemption_preparation.limits: Fresh pre-write snapshot, reviewed activation/audit contract, actual GoTrue verification and required deployment approval remain necessary. Saved SQL is review-only. This record contains no business row hashes or personal row contents.
